headline: Over 19.6 million children were vaccinated in the first three days of Pakistan's sub-national polio campaign, which targets 24 million children in 97 districts until 8 November, the NEOC said, Arab News reports.

card.desc: 97 districts mein 24 million bachon ka hadaf, muhim 8 November tak

caption:
Polio muhim ke pehle 3 din mein 19.6 million se zyada bachon ki vaccination!
Arab News ke mutabiq NEOC ne bataya ke Monday ko shuru hone wali sub-national polio muhim 97 districts mein 24 million bachon ki vaccination ke liye 8 November tak jari rahegi. Is saal ab tak 8 wild poliovirus cases report hue hain.
Kya aap ke bachon ki vaccination ho gayi? Comment mein batayein 👇
